allocator_ownership.failure: A CUDA KV hook was allocated through the shared model allocator but destroyed through the caller allocator supplied by KvStorageRuntime. The admitted document allocator interpreted the foreign allocation as its own header, corrupting heap metadata.
allocator_ownership.fix: CUDA and Metal hooks now destroy all owned state with their creation allocator. Audio physical calls use the reclaiming document work allocator and copy the finished text into the page arena.
allocator_ownership.regression: Separate bounded owner and request allocators verify that CUDA hook teardown releases its owner allocation without charging/freeing the request allocator.
allocator_ownership.reproducer: Valgrind located the foreign-allocator free; correcting the callback allocator in the original binary cleared the reproducer. The rebuilt production binary now passes the complete 73-clip corpus and all direct/planned transport, silence, and duration checks.
